# JHammerZ Official Music & Developer Hub

> Official music catalog, acoustic sessions, and multi-channel developer hub by Joshua Hamilton (JHammerZ).

## Master Audio Sessions

- [Ain't Nothin' But A Day To Die](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=URLBudn8pDg): Original acoustic take featuring MadLad Gibson on mandolin.
- [Freebird](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=Z45xajWiXwc): Raw acoustic session take.
- [Mad World](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=0tqYahK4a3E): Gary Jules acoustic cover session.
- [Won't Back Down](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=gqZNhmRizLE): Tom Petty tribute acoustic take.
- [Behind Blue Eyes](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=6fWkO3evvdw): Acoustic guitar and vocal session take.
- [Little Lion Man](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=KwyoClPYIy0): Mumford & Sons acoustic cover.

## Streaming & Social Hubs

- [Spotify Artist Catalog](https://open.spotify.com/artist/7vRd2EDcwuEYWtyqW28a79): Official artist discography and master streams.
- [Apple Music](https://music.apple.com/us/artist/jhammerz/1845705346): Official iTunes catalog releases.
- [BandLab Portal](https://www.bandlab.com/band/band8670133842983447): Demos and collaborative project audio nodes.
- [Amazon Music](https://music.amazon.com/artists/B0D5GLL7NV/jhammerz): Digital store and Prime streaming.
- [YouTube Channel](https://www.youtube.com/@JHammerZ): Live performance sessions.
- [TikTok Shorts](https://www.tiktok.com/@jhammerzz): Short-form one-take riffs and vocal sessions.
- [Facebook Community](https://www.facebook.com/JHammerZz): Official broadcasts and community dispatches.
- [GitHub Repository](https://github.com/JHammerZ/jhammerz.github.io): Source code and edge CI/CD pipelines.
